results.optimization: Work-group size 1→256 for quantized copy kernels (f32_q, q_f32)
results.notes: Work-group size increased from 1 to 256 for all quantized copy kernels. Added SYCL_CPY_QUANT_BLOCK_SIZE=256. Added [[intel::reqd_sub_group_size(16)]] attribute. Correctness: 131/131 CPY tests passed. Benchmark shows minimal improvement on test sizes - quantization compute may be bottleneck.
